# keys: # Each symbol on each key, in the slot it can occupy.
# 吧 嗎 啦 喔 的 lead here because a neutral tone also answers to tones 2-4;
# that is the known cost of keeping 早上 and 太太 findable, below.
# Tone 1 has no key. Other tones can be left out, on syllables with and without a tone 1.
# z c s stand for both and show the commoner, ㄓㄔㄕ, whichever candidate leads.
# i shows ㄧ unless only ㄞ can follow the initial.
# A word stays findable under the tone a typist gives, against an exact word on the same keys.
